name: OECD Well-being Database (How's Life?)

measures.definition: How satisfied people say they are with their life as a whole, on a 0 to 10 scale, averaged over the country.

licence: OECD terms for data (any use, with citation)

notices: Reusers must cite the OECD as above and pass this acknowledgement requirement on to anyone they share the data with.

vetted.notes: Open alternative to the World Happiness Report, whose data may not be redistributed.

caveats: Only OECD members; elsewhere the line stays empty rather than borrowing a closed index.
The OECD API answers HTTP 500 intermittently; the fetch reports it and can be re-run for this source alone (borgo fetch <place> --only oecd-wellbeing).
